entries.description: An educational, job skill, rural skill, and growth center on 52 acres of farmland, hills, and woods near Portland, Oregon. It features Star House for visitors, has four resident lesbians, and welcomes new members, non-lesbian women, and women with children.
entries.raw_text: WHO FARM INC 37010 SE Snuffin Rd, Estacada, OR 97023 (503)630-6728. Who farm is an educational, job skill, rural skill and growth center for womyn of all ages, races, cultures and backgrounds. We have 52 acres of beautiful farmland, fields, hills, evergreens, a visitor’s house in the magical woods called Star House. Our land is located approx 30 miles SE of Portland with a city bus (NO 31) running within 5 miles of the farm. Visitors may stay max 2 weeks. We charge $4 per night’s stay in Star House. Womyn with dependent children are welcome. Bring your own food. We have very rainy weather and lots of mud so sisters bring rain gear and goulashes! There’s no electricity in Star House. We welcome: new members/residents. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 52 acres, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living on the land, inactive group with hopes to revive (trying to get back on our feet).
entries.notes: Type Retreat/Gathering Space per codebook rule explicitly citing Who Farm Inc as an educational center. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (directory context, 4 resident lesbians); Non-lesbian women from 'for womyn of all ages, races, cultures and backgrounds' (pre-1986 rule); Girl children and Boy children from 'Womyn with dependent children are welcome'. Focus Workshops/education from 'educational, job skill, rural skill and growth center'. Distance to Portland left out of land_location_as_stated per rule. Street address copied to land fields.

entries.description: A non-profit educational community organization on 60 acres in Seal Rock, Oregon, teaching rural skills to women and children. It offers camping, cabins for trade/rent, and group rentals, and welcomes new members, non-lesbian women, girl and boy children, and work exchanges.
entries.raw_text: PENTHESILEIA, INC Box 97 Star Route 2, Seal Rock, OR 97376 (503)563-3643. Penthesileia, Inc is a non-profit educational community organization teaching rural skills to women and their children. A matrix between rural and urban. We have camping spaces and cabins for trade and rent. Group rentals available. No violence. We welcome: new members/residents, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, leashed dogs, work exchanges. We have/are: 60 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type Retreat/Gathering Space per codebook rule explicitly citing Penthesileia Inc as an educational center. num_residents is blank because no specific count of resident lesbians or women is given. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (directory context, women living/working on land); Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'); Girl children and Boy children ('girl and boy children'). Focus Workshops/education from 'educational community organization teaching rural skills'. Star Route address copied to land fields per rural route rule.

entries.description: An intentional community of five lesbians in Roseburg, Oregon, with gardens, orchards, chickens, sheep, and ponies, supported by jobs in town. Visitors are accepted by arrangement with fees or work exchange; girl children, boy babies, and non-lesbian women are welcome.
entries.raw_text: RAINBOW'S END Rt 3 Box 3645, Roseburg, OR 97470 (503)673-7649. Our land embraces food and flower gardens, orchards, woods and pasture. We raise chickens, sheep and working ponies. We're paying for our home by working various jobs in town. Visitor policy: visits must be prearranged by mail or phone. Land use fee: $2-$4 per day, food: $4 per day. Sometimes, for specific projects, work exchange may be arranged. No dogs!!! We welcome: girl children, boy babies, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 5 lesbians, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land, women working in town.
entries.notes: Type Intentional Community/Cooperative: 5 lesbians living and working on the land. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (5 resident lesbians); Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'); Girl children ('girl children'); Boy children ('boy babies', conditioned on babyhood). Focus Farming/self-sufficiency from 'food and flower gardens, orchards, woods and pasture. We raise chickens, sheep and working ponies.' Rural route address copied to land fields.

entries.description: A community of six lesbians and four children in Wolf Creek, Oregon, living on and working the land. They do not allow drop-ins and welcome new members and girl and boy children.
entries.raw_text: GOLDENWIMMIN 3502 Coyote Creek Rd, Wolf Creek, OR 97497 (503)866-2520. We are a group of hard working wimmin and 4 children. Write or call first. Absolutely no drop ins. We welcome: new members/residents, girl and boy children. We have/are: 6 lesbians, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living on and working the land.
entries.notes: Type Intentional Community/Cooperative: group of 6 lesbians and 4 children living on the land and recruiting new members. num_residents is 10 (6 resident lesbians plus 4 children, per rule that members' children count). Accepted groups: Lesbian women (6 lesbians); Girl children and Boy children ('girl and boy children'). Non-lesbian women not coded because they are not listed under 'We welcome:'. Street address copied to land fields.

entries.description: A feminist retreat on 23 forested acres in southern Oregon with 5-10 resident lesbians. They offer summer and winter sessions with workshops and skill-sharing for 10-30 women, have a main house and cabins, and welcome girl children.
entries.raw_text: WOMANSHARE Box 681, Grants Pass, OR 97526 (503)862-2807. A feminist retreat on forested land in Southern OR. We plan summer and winter sessions for 10-30 women - workshops, skillsharing, discussion groups, recreation and home-cooked meals. We have a main house and several women-built cabins for sleeping and many secluded spots for camping. The main house has electricity, hot water and a shower. Visitors are asked to contribute $3/day for food and $1-3/day to our land support fund. We welcome: girl children. We have/are: 5-10 lesbians, 23 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity (outdoor toilet), camping space, woods, farmland, women living/working on the land.
entries.notes: Type Retreat/Gathering Space: explicitly calls itself 'A feminist retreat'. num_residents is 5 (smaller number of range '5-10 lesbians' with 'women living/working on the land'). Land state OR from 'Southern OR'. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (directory context, resident lesbians); Girl children ('girl children'). Non-lesbian women not coded because 'We welcome:' explicitly specifies only 'girl children'. Focus Workshops/education from 'workshops, skillsharing, discussion groups'. PO Box address, so land street and zip left blank.

entries.description: Sixteen acres of basically undeveloped land in Oregon lived on and worked by one lesbian. Short visits of 3-4 days are offered in exchange for work; girl children are welcome.
entries.raw_text: MULLEINSONG PO Box 302, Applegate, OR 97530. Single woman living on basically undeveloped land. Visitors welcome for 3-4 days in exchange for some work. Please write ahead of time. We welcome: girl children. We have/are: 1 lesbian, 16 acres, camping space, woods, women living on and working the land.
entries.notes: Type Private/Individual Land per two-woman rule: single woman living on land ('Single woman living on basically undeveloped land', '1 lesbian'). Land state OR inferred from Applegate, OR PO Box. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (1 resident lesbian); Girl children ('girl children'). PO Box address, so land street and zip left blank.

entries.description: An oceanfront residential community of about 15 lesbians in St. Augustine, Florida, with a community center and cottages available for lease. They welcome new members, girl children, and non-lesbian women as non-resident members only.
entries.raw_text: THE PAGODA COMMUNITY 207 Coastal Hwy-LC, St Augustine, FL 32084 (904)824-2970. We are a residential community with a community center where members can stay for limited visits. Membership is $10-$20/mo. We currently have two cottages available for 1 year lease. We welcome: new members/residents (we rent cottages on a monthly basis only), girl children, nonlesbian women (as non-resident members only). We have/are: about 15 lesbians, small community on ocean, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity.

Included per codebook: 'a lesbian residential community on its own property even without acreage (Pagoda, under that note)'. Other entries under this note (Ellie's Nest, River Most Wild) are excluded per explicit codebook instructions.
